description: This file is a PHP source code file defining a controller class for the OpenCart admin dashboard related to customer statistics and information.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Controller class for managing the customer dashboard in the OpenCart admin panel, including viewing and saving customer-related data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the customer dashboard view, loads necessary language, and prepares data for the dashboard page.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves configuration settings for the customer dashboard, with permission validation and JSON response.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Prepares data for and returns the customer dashboard view, including statistics such as total customers and their percentage change.
